open_points.subject: _encrypt_backup
open_points.text: _encrypt_backup: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST seal under an AES-GCM key of the imported BACKUP_KEY_BYTES constant in bytes, derived by HKDF with the hash of the cryptography package whose name equals the one the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant holds, the hash built by its class and its name compared with the constant, never chosen through hash names written in the code, and no salt from the bytes of backup_key with those of the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_INFO constant as its info, both encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, using the cryptography package, and MUST pass the record line's bytes without its line feed as the associated data, so that a changed record fails the decryption.
open_points.rule: - Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: Replace the class-construction and name-comparison procedure with a behavioral requirement that the imported constant selects the cryptography hash algorithm, leaving the implementation mechanics out of the note.
